'''Reclamation Services, Inc.''' ('''RSI''') was a [[Tal'cara]]-based corporation that specialized in recycling waste materials. It was operated by [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] of the [[Ubskai]] [[clan]], and it was owned by its leader, [[Ukert]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
==History==
The combined funds of the Ubskai clan allowed its leader, the [[smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] Ukert, buy and modify a small fleet of [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder trucks]] that collected junk which he then could smuggle to customers, and moved to an abandoned warehouse where they opened their operation.

After smelting and incineration, the company recycled waste materials and turned them into usable forms, such as [[metal/Legends|metals]], [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] and [[Silicate/Legends|silicates]], which were sold again. The company was profitable as it operated on very low costs, and covered Ukert's smuggling operations.<ref name="guide" /><ref name="GR">''{{WEGCite|story=Garbage Run|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}''</ref>

The company owned a dozen of modified [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder trucks]] that followed a circuit around the city collecting recyclables; the trucks also carried concealed cargo, delivered to Ukert's customers. It also provided [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] for hire by the outlying manufacturing plants; once a [[local month/Legends|month]] Ukert ran a freighter to [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]] (their biggest contact) not only to collect recyclables, but also to carry concealed [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster ammo packs]] (intended for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]).<ref name="guide" />
